'''The Gauntlet''' is a solo [[minigame]] in [[Prifddinas]] in which the player is given a limited amount of time to explore a randomly generated dungeon layout, gather various resources and supplies by skilling and defeating crystalline monsters, all in preparation to defeat the [[Crystalline Hunllef]], which is based upon a [[Hunllef (race)|deadly wolf-like predator]] from the elven homeworld of [[Tarddiad]]. The Gauntlet was created as a training ground by the [[Amlodd Clan]] to ensure their warriors were capable of defending Prifddinas during the [[God Wars]].{{CiteNPC|npc=Bryn|quote=This here is the Gauntlet, the finest creation of the Amlodd clan. It was built years ago to help train Prifddinas' finest warriors and survivalists.|loc=|notes=|name=}}

The Gauntlet can be found by entering the [[Gauntlet Portal]], found in the north-western part of Prifddinas.

Players '''cannot''' bring any items into the Gauntlet; when entering the minigame, all items currently on the player will be automatically stored for its duration. Any pre-applied skill boosts will also be removed upon entry to the Gauntlet. It is a dangerous minigame, so [[hardcore ironmen]] will lose their hardcore status, and ultimate ironmen will lose items in [[instanced banks]] should they die in The Gauntlet.

The area contains resource nodes, [[grym leaf|herbs]] and [[raw paddlefish|fish]] obtainable through [[Mining]], [[Woodcutting]], [[Fishing]] and other gathering methods, in order to make weapons, armour, potions and food. These various resources do not require a specific skill level to gather. The dungeon will also contain various crystalline monsters, such as [[Crystalline Bat|bats]], [[Crystalline Unicorn|unicorns]] and [[Crystalline Dark Beast|dark beasts]], which can be killed for further supplies. Higher level monsters will offer better drops at the cost of taking more time to defeat.

Completion of The Gauntlet will reward players with various loot, including [[crystal armour seed]]s for [[crystal armour]], as well as [[enhanced crystal weapon seed]]s for the [[Blade of Saeldor]] or the [[Bow of Faerdhinen]] and the [[crystal shard]]s required to charge the items. Failing to finish, either by death or leaving early, will give a small token reward based upon how well the player performed, but will not grant any chance of unique items.

==Basic overview==
{{Has calculator|Calculator:Gauntlet resources}}
The map consists of a 7x7 grid of rooms, and the player starts adjacent to the centre room that contains The Gauntlet's boss: the [[Crystalline Hunllef]]. The player has 10 minutes to prepare to fight this boss, which is indicated by a timer. If the timer runs out, the player will automatically get teleported into the boss room. The player can also choose to manually enter the boss room before the timer ends.

During this 10 minute preparation time, the player may use the resources of The Gauntlet's environment to create a set up to challenge the Crystalline Hunllef. This set up may consist of three tiers of halberds, staves, bows, helmets, body armours and leg armours, as well as food and a potion that restores [[run energy]] and [[prayer points]].

===Starting room===
[[File:The Gauntlet Starting Room.png|200px|right|thumb|Features of the starting room]]
The player will start adjacent to the central room. This room contains features that are used for processing the collected resources.
*'''[[Crystal Singing Recipes (The Gauntlet)|Crystal Singing Recipes]]:''' A bookstand players can click to get an overview of all recipes for armour and weaponry found within The Gauntlet.
*'''[[Egniol Potions]]:''' A bookstand players can click to read a text describing the use and recipe of [[egniol potion]]s.
*'''[[Range (The Gauntlet)|Range]]:''' Used to cook {{plink|Raw paddlefish}} into {{plink|Paddlefish}}.
*'''[[Singing Bowl]]:''' Used to craft vials, teleport crystals, [[crystal paddlefish]], [[corrupted paddlefish]], armour and weapons.
*'''[[Teleport Platform (The Gauntlet)|Teleport Platform]]:''' Used to abandon the current challenge.
*'''[[Tool Storage]]:''' Used to re-obtain [[crystal sceptre]], [[Crystal axe (The Gauntlet)|crystal axe]], [[Crystal pickaxe (The Gauntlet)|crystal pickaxe]], [[Crystal harpoon (The Gauntlet)|crystal harpoon]] and [[Pestle and mortar (The Gauntlet)|pestle and mortar]]
*'''[[Water Pump (The Gauntlet)|Water Pump]]:''' Used to turn {{plink|Vial (The Gauntlet)|txt=vials}} into {{plink|Water-filled vial|txt=water-filled vials}}, which are needed to make {{plink|Egniol potion (3)|txt=Egniol potions}}.
{{Clear}}

===Resource rooms===
Each room in The Gauntlet, except for the starting room and the boss room, contains resource nodes and/or monsters. These resource nodes and monsters are farmed to collect resources that can be processed at the [[Singing Bowl]] in the starting room.

====Resource nodes====
[[File:Phren Roots.png|right|100px]]
There are five types of resource nodes. Each resource room will contain zero to five resource nodes. A resource room may contain a combination of different resource nodes.
*'''[[Crystal Deposit]]:''' Used to mine [[crystal ore]] from. Three crystal ores can be collected from each Crystal Deposit. Used for creating armour within The Gauntlet.
*'''[[Linum Tirinum (plant)|Linum Tirinum]]:''' Used to pick [[linum tirinum]] from. Three linum tirinum can be collected from each Linum Tirinum plant. Used for creating armour within The Gauntlet.
*'''[[Phren Roots]]:''' Used to chop [[phren bark]] from. Three phren barks can be collected from each Phren Roots plant. Used for creating armour within The Gauntlet.
*'''[[Grym Root]]:''' Used to pick a [[grym leaf]] from. One grym leaf can be collected from each Grym Root plant. Used for creating Egniol potions within The Gauntlet.
*'''[[Fishing Spot (The Gauntlet)|Fishing Spot]]:''' Used to fish [[raw paddlefish]] from. Four raw paddlefish can be collected from each Fishing Spot. Used for food within The Gauntlet, healing 20 Hitpoints when cooked. Also counts as a water source to fill vials.

Collecting resources from the aforementioned nodes may reward the player with [[Crystal shards (The Gauntlet)|crystal shards]].

The inner 3x3 area adjacent to the boss room is guaranteed to include 4 rooms containing each at least 3 Crystal Deposits, Linum Tirinum, Phren Roots and weak monsters respectively.
This does not apply to the [[Corrupted Gauntlet]].

====Monsters====
There are nine types of monsters that can be found within the resource rooms, that can be categorized into three categories:
*'''Weak monsters:''' [[Crystalline Spider]]s (level 22), [[Crystalline Rat]]s (level 23) and [[Crystalline Bat]]s (level 33).
*'''Strong monsters:''' [[Crystalline Unicorn]]s (level 45), [[Crystalline Scorpion]]s (level 64) and [[Crystalline Wolf|Crystalline Wolves]] (level 69).
*'''Demi-bosses:''' [[Crystalline Bear]]s (level 172), [[Crystalline Dragon]]s (level 172) and [[Crystalline Dark Beast]]s (level 172).

[[File:Weapon frame detail.png|right|100px]]
[[File:Crystal spike detail.png|right|100px]]
The above monsters may be killed for the following items:
*'''[[Crystal shards (The Gauntlet)|Crystal shards]]:''' Used for processing items at the [[Singing Bowl]].
*'''[[Weapon frame]]:''' Used for creating the lowest tier bow, halberd or staff at the Singing Bowl.
*'''[[Raw paddlefish]]:''' Used for food within The Gauntlet, healing 20 [[Hitpoints]] when eaten cooked.
*'''[[Grym leaf]]:''' Used for creating [[Egniol potion]]s within The Gauntlet.
*'''[[Teleport crystal (The Gauntlet)|Teleport crystal]]:''' Used for teleporting to the starting room.
*'''[[Crystal spike]]:''' Used to create the highest tier halberd. Guaranteed drop from the first [[Crystalline Bear]] killed.
*'''[[Crystal orb]]:''' Used to create the highest tier staff. Guaranteed drop from the first [[Crystalline Dragon]] killed.
*'''[[Crystalline bowstring]]:''' Used to create the highest tier bow. Guaranteed drop from the first [[Crystalline Dark Beast]] killed.

===Armour and weaponry===
The Singing Bowl can be used to create armour and weapons. Since the Crystalline Hunllef uses [[protection prayers]], at least two different types of weapons are required.

====Weapons====
[[File:Crystal halberd (perfected) equipped male.png|right|x250px]]
There are three types of weapons: bows ([[Ranged]]), halberds ([[Melee]]) and staves ([[Magic]]). These weapons are available in three tiers: basic, attuned and perfected. Higher tiers are created by upgrading from their previous tiers.

The creation of each of the three weapon types requires the same resources:
*'''Basic''' (tier 1): A [[weapon frame]].
*'''Attuned''' (tier 2): Basic weapon and 50 [[Crystal shards (The Gauntlet)|crystal shards]].
*'''Perfected''' (tier 3): Attuned weapon and a [[crystal spike]] (for the halberd), [[crystal orb]] (for the staff) or [[crystalline bowstring]] (for the bow).

Weapons from higher tiers give the player higher accuracy and/or damage. See the table below for an overview of each weapon's bonuses:

===Boss room===
[[File:Crystalline Hunllef.png|right|150px]]
After the 10 minute timer expires the player is automatically teleported into the boss room. The player may also choose to manually pass through the [[Barrier (The Gauntlet)|barrier]] into the boss room if they're ready before the timer has expired. During the fight, players who wish to escape must '''right-click''' the barrier and choose the "'''Escape'''" option.

The boss room always lies directly adjacent to the starting room.

If the player dies as the boss dies, kill count credit will not be awarded.

==Corrupted Gauntlet==
[[File:The Corrupted Gauntlet.png|thumb|300px|A player in the Corrupted Gauntlet.]]
After completing the Gauntlet once, players may try the Corrupted Gauntlet, which has increased difficulty compared to the regular Gauntlet.

Differences include:
*All monsters are Corrupted instead of Crystalline, with increased stats.
*All items are Corrupted instead of Crystal, with the same stats.
*The player only has 7 minutes and 30 seconds to prepare compared to the normal version at 10 minutes.
*Resource generation of the inner 3x3 area adjacent to the boss room does not have randomness mitigation, with the exception of one room being guaranteed to contain 3 fishing spots.

===Boss Room===
*The boss room instead contains the [[Corrupted Hunllef]], which has 1000 health and increased aggressive stats. The table below describes its max hit while wearing different combinations of armour while using the correct protection prayer against its magic and ranged attacks.
**If running full T2, consider making a T3 helm instead of a T2 body if you have spare shards. At the cost of 20 more shards, you'll gain +4 defence bonus stats whilst still retaining the T2 reduced damage effect, even though you technically did not have a full T2 set.
***It appears that the sum of armour tiers being worn is what determines the max hit of Hunllef's attacks and tornadoes, as 2 T3 pieces provided the same damage reduction as a full set of T2 armour.

===Rewards===
Completing the Corrupted Gauntlet rewards three rolls on an upgraded loot table. The player will also receive a {{plink|Gauntlet cape}} upon completion.

==Loot table==
{{Main|Reward Chest (The Gauntlet)}}
{{Listen
|title = [[Clearing the Gauntlet]]
|align = right
|filename = Clearing the Gauntlet.ogg
|desc = The jingle that plays upon completing the Gauntlet.}}

Upon completing The Gauntlet's challenge, players will receive two rolls on the regular loot table, several [[crystal shard]]s and a roll for the unique rewards. For more information on the loot table, visit the [[Reward Chest (The Gauntlet)|Reward Chest]]'s page.

Upon completion of the Corrupted challenge, players will receive three rolls on an upgraded loot table, several crystal shards and a roll for the unique rewards with a higher chance of success.

Upon failing the challenge, players might still get rewarded with some lower value loot.

|date = 22 July 2026
|update = Summer Sweep-Up Gear & PvM Changes
|change = 
* The north/east/south/west-most rooms from the centre now have a guaranteed random demi-boss spawn.
* Demi-bosses can spawn in any edge or corner room.
* Demi-bosses have had their attack range reduced from 16 to 10.
* Non-demi-boss enemies now have standardised defensive stats.
* [[Weapon frame]]s are now guaranteed from killing the first [[Crystalline Spider|crystalline spider]], [[Crystalline Rat|rat]], or [[Crystalline Bat|bat]].
* [[Phren bark]], [[crystal ore]] and [[linum tirinum]] are now stackable.
* [[Crystal shards (The Gauntlet)|Crystal shards]] are now automatically placed in the [[inventory]]. 
* The quantity of crystal shards dropped by enemies now has a smaller range.
* Crystal shard costs for crafting various pieces of equipment have been adjusted:
** Creating a tier 1 weapon requires no crystal shards, down from 20.
** Creating a tier 2 weapon requires 50 crystal shards, down from 60.
** Creating a piece of tier 1 armour requires 50 crystal shards, up from 40.
** Creating a piece of tier 2 body armour requires 100 crystal shards, up from 60. 
** Creating a piece of tier 2 leg or helmet armour requires 50 crystal shards, down from 60.
** Creating a piece of tier 3 armour requires 100 crystal shards, up from 80.
* [[Gauntlet Speed-Chaser]] now requires a completion in under 4:45, down from 5:00.
* [[Gauntlet Speed-Runner]] now requires a completion in under 3:45, down from 4:00.
* [[Corrupted Gauntlet Speed-Chaser]] now requires a completion in under 7:05, down from 7:30.
* [[Corrupted Gauntlet Speed-Runner]] now requires a completion in under 6:05, down from 6:30.
}}
